text: Skyscraper-sized twisted crystals: transparent with refraction (by day and/or night)
description: A forest that mixes organic and constructional forms, solarpunk, 3D noisy and twisting. Analytic SDF: a twist domain warp plus noise warp on elongated hexagonal prisms; raymarching makes refraction cheap.

status.comment: First step in code: fader `crystals` (city tab, 0..1, default 0) = fraction of cells (by cell hash) drawn as twisted hexagonal prisms in scene.vert: 6 sides x 6 rings, per-cell twist up to +-3 rad over the height, taper to 0.65, six-sided tip over the top 20%, flat facet normals; scene instance now draws 234 vertices (boxes use the first 30). Collision/raycast still use the cell's box (contains the crystal). Verified: glslangValidator compiles scene.vert, cargo check passes. NOT yet seen: needs a look in dev.sh (set crystals to 0.3-1). Refraction not started. Open for Felix: replace the blocks or mix (the fader answers it live), keep night windows on crystals?
